title: Two different operations with identical records and no ids
policy: P4 (accepted limitation): with neither id, two operations whose timestamp, model and counters are all identical can't be told apart and count once. The total is marked uncertain, not exact.
derivation: Two separate operations both logged as 16:25:00 [100, 50] without ids. Really 300 tokens; the fingerprint can't distinguish them, so 150, one fingerprinted operation. This expected value is the agreed best effort, not the true total.
